verses.geez:
ወዐርገ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እምነ ፡ አራቦ[ት] ፡ ዘሞአብ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ና[በው] ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ ፈስጋ ፡ ዘሀለወ ፡
                  ቅድመ ፡ ኢያሪኮ ፡ ወአርአዮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ገላአድ ፤
verses.translation: And Moses went up from Araboth Moab to the mount of Nabau, to the top of Phasga, which is before Jericho; and the Lord shewed him all the mount of Galaad to Dan, and all the land of Nephthali,

translations.lxx: And Moses went up from Araboth Moab to the mount of Nabau, to the top of Phasga, which is before Jericho; and the Lord shewed him all the mount of Galaad to Dan, and all the land of Nephthali,
translations.kjv: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,
translations.ron: Atunci s-a suit Moise din şesurile Moabului în Muntele Nebo, pe vârful Fazga, care este în faţa Ierihonului, şi i-a arătat Domnul tot pământul Galaad până la Dan,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνεβη Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ Ἀραβὼθ Μωὰβ ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος Ναβαῦ, ἐπὶ κορυφὴν Φασγὰ, ἥ ἐστιν ἐπὶ προσώπου Ἱεριχώ· καὶ ἔδειξεν αὐτῷ Κύριος πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Γαλαὰδ ἕως Δὰν,

verses.geez: ወኵሎ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ንፍታሌም ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ምናሴ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ እስከ ፡ ደኃሪት ፡ ባሕር ፤
verses.translation: and all the land of Ephraim and Manasse, and all the land of Juda to the farthest sea;

translations.lxx: and all the land of Ephraim and Manasse, and all the land of Juda to the farthest sea;
translations.kjv: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,
translations.ron: Tot pământul lui Neftali, tot pământul lui Efraim şi Manase şi tot pământul lui Iuda până la marea cea de la asfinţit,
translations.grk: καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Νεφθαλὶ, καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Ἐφραὶμ, καὶ Μανασσῆ, καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Ἰούδα ἕως τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς ἐσχάτης,

verses.geez: ወገዳሙ ፡ ወአድያሚሃ ፡ ለኢያሪኮ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ፊንቆን ፡ እስከ ፡ ሴይር ።
verses.translation: and the wilderness, and the country round about Jericho, the city of palm-trees, to Segor.

translations.lxx: and the wilderness, and the country round about Jericho, the city of palm-trees, to Segor.
translations.kjv: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.
translations.ron: Partea de la miazăzi a ţării, şesul Ierihonului, cetatea Palmierilor, până la Ţoar.
translations.grk: καὶ τὴν ἔρημον, καὶ τὰ περίχωρα Ἱεριχὼ, πόλιν φοινίκων ἕως Σηγώρ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ መሐልኩ ፡ ለአብርሃም ፡ ወለይስሐቅ ፡ ወለያዕቆብ ፡ ወእቤሎሙ
                  ፡ ለዘርእከ ፡ እሁባ ፡ ወናሁ ፡ አርአይኩካሃ ፡ [ለከ ፡ በአዕይንቲከ ፡] ወህየ ፡ ባሕቱ ፡ ኢትበውእ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, This is the land of which I sware to Abraam, and Isaac, and Jacob, saying, To your seed will I give it: and I have shewed it to thine eyes, but thou shalt not go in thither.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, This is the land of which I sware to Abraam, and Isaac, and Jacob, saying, To your seed will I give it: and I have shewed it to thine eyes, but thou shalt not go in thither.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.
translations.ron: Şi i-a zis Domnul: "Iată pământul pentru care M-am jurat lui Avraam, lui Isaac şi lui Iacov, zicând: Seminţiei tale îl voi da. Te-am învrednicit să-l vezi cu ochii tăi; dar în el nu vei intra!
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, αὕτη ἡ γῆ ἣν ὤμοσα τῷ Ἁβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ, λέγων, τῷ σπέρματι ὑμῶν δώσω αὐτήν· καὶ ἔδειξα τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς σου, καὶ ἐκεῖ οὐκ εἰσελεύσῃ.

verses.geez: ወሞተ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ቍልዔሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በምድረ ፡ ሞአብ ፡ በቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: So Moses the servant of the Lord died in the land of Moab by the word of the Lord.

translations.lxx: So Moses the servant of the Lord died in the land of Moab by the word of the Lord.
translations.kjv: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.
translations.ron: Şi a murit Moise, robul lui Dumnezeu, acolo, în pământul Moabului, după Cuvântul Domnului;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐτελεύτησε Μωυσῆς ὁ οἰκέτης Κυρίου ἐν γῇ Μωὰβ διὰ ῥήματος Κυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወቀበርዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ቅሩበ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ፌጎር ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘያአምር ፡ መኑሂ ፡ መቃብሮ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ዕለት
                  ።
verses.translation: And they buried him in Gai near the house of Phogor; and no one has seen his sepulchre to this day.

translations.lxx: And they buried him in Gai near the house of Phogor; and no one has seen his sepulchre to this day.
translations.kjv: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Bethpeor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
translations.ron: Şi a fost îngropat în vale, în pământul Moabului, în faţa Bet-Peorului, dar nimeni nu ştie mormântul lui nici până în ziua de astăzi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν ἐν Γαὶ ἐγγὺς οἴκου Φογώρ· καὶ οὐκ εἶδεν οὐδεὶς τὴν ταφὴν αὐτοῦ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης.

verses.geez: ወምእት ፡ ወዕሥራ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ አመ ፡ ሞተ ፡ ወኢተሐምጋ ፡ አዕይንቲሁ ፡ ወኢማሰና ።
verses.translation: And Moses was a hundred and twenty years old at his death; his eyes were not dimmed, nor were his natural powers destroyed.

translations.lxx: And Moses was a hundred and twenty years old at his death; his eyes were not dimmed, nor were his natural powers destroyed.
translations.kjv: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
translations.ron: Şi era Moise de o sută douăzeci de ani, când a murit; dar vederea lui nu slăbise şi tăria lui nu se împuţinase.
translations.grk: Μωυσῆς δὲ ἦν ἑκατὸν καὶ εἴκοσι ἐτῶν ἐν τῷ τελευτᾷν αὐτόν· οὐκ ἠμαυρώθησαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ, οὐδὲ ἐφθάρησαν τὰ χελώνια αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወበከይዎ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ በአራቦት ፡ ዘሞአብ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ኢያሪኮ ፡ ሠላሳ ፡
                  መዋዕለ ፡ ወተፈጸመ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ላሑ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ዘበከይዎ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in Araboth of Moab at Jordan near Jericho thirty days; and the days of the sad mourning for Moses were completed.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in Araboth of Moab at Jordan near Jericho thirty days; and the days of the sad mourning for Moses were completed.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.
translations.ron: Şi au plâns fiii lui Israel pe Moise, în şesurile Moabului, la Iordan, aproape de Ierihon, treizeci de zile, până s-au împlinit zilele de jelit şi de plâns după Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔκλαυσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ Μωυσῆν ἐν Ἀραβὼθ Μωὰβ ἐπὶ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου κατὰ Ἱεριχὼ τριάκοντα ἡμέρας, καὶ συνετελέσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι πένθους κλαυθμοῦ Μωυσῆ.

verses.geez:
ወኢየሱስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ነዌ ፡ ተመልአ ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ ጥበብ ፡ እስመ ፡ ወደየ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ወተአዘዙ ፡ ሎቱ
                  ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወገብሩ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And Joshua the son of Naue was filled with the spirit of knowledge, for Moses had laid his hands upon him; and the children of Israel hearkened to him; and they did as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: And Joshua the son of Naue was filled with the spirit of knowledge, for Moses had laid his hands upon him; and the children of Israel hearkened to him; and they did as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.ron: Iar Iosua, fiul lui Navi, s-a umplut de duhul înţelepciunii, pentru că îşi pusese Moise mâinile asupra lui, şi i s-au supus fiii lui Israel şi au făcut aşa după cum le poruncise Domnul prin Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ Ἰησοῦς υἱὸς Ναυῆ ἐνεπλήσθη πνεύματος συνέσεως, ἐπέθηκε γὰρ Μωυσῆς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοὺ ἐπʼ αὐτόν· καὶ εἰσήκουσαν αὐτοῦ οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραήλ· καὶ ἐποίησαν καθότι ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez: ወኢተንሥአ ፡ እንከ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ዘተናገሮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ገጸ ፡ በገጽ ፤
verses.translation: And there rose up no more a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,

translations.lxx: And there rose up no more a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,
translations.kjv: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
translations.ron: De atunci nu s-a mai ridicat în Israel prooroc asemenea lui Moise pe care Dumnezeu să-l fi cunoscut fată către faţă, nici să săvârşească toate semnele şi minunile cu care Domnul l-a trimis în pământul Egiptului asupra lui Faraon şi asupra tuturor dregătorilor lui şi asupra a tot pământul lui; nici să facă cu mână tare şi cu mari înfricoşări ceea ce a făcut Moise înaintea ochilor a tot Israelul.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἀνέστη ἔτι προφήτης ἐν Ἰσραὴλ ὡς Μωσῆς· ὃν ἔγνω Κύριος αὐτὸν πρόσωπον κατὰ πρόσωπον

verses.geez:
ወበኵሉ ፡ ተአምር ፡ ወመድምም ፡ ዘፈነዎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበሮ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡
                  ወላዕለ ፡ መገብቱ ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ ምድሩ ፤
verses.translation: in all the signs and wonders, which the Lord sent him to work in Egypt on Pharao, and his servants, and all his land;

translations.lxx: in all the signs and wonders, which the Lord sent him to work in Egypt on Pharao, and his servants, and all his land;
translations.kjv: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
translations.grk: ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς σημείοις καὶ τέρασιν, ὃν ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν Κύριος ποιῆσαι αὐτὰ ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ Φαραὼ, καὶ τοῖς θεράπουσιν αὐτοῦ, καὶ πάσῃ τῇ γῇ αὐτοῦ·

verses.geez:
ዐበይት ፡ መድምም ፡ ወእድ ፡ ጽንዕት ፡ ወመዝራዕት ፡ ልዑል ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ እስራኤል
                  ።
verses.translation: the great wonders, and the mighty hand which Moses displayed before all Israel.

translations.lxx: the great wonders, and the mighty hand which Moses displayed before all Israel.
translations.kjv: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.
translations.grk: τὰ θαυμάσια τὰ μεγάλα, καὶ τὴν χεῖρα τὴν κραταιὰν, ἃ ἐποίησε Μωυσῆς ἔναντι παντὸς Ἰσραήλ.
